title: Codex run trace ID propagation for AI observability and Slack ratings
answers: Why does a rating on a Codex Slack response point to an empty trace?
Why do Codex generations appear as single-request traces in AI observability?
How are trace IDs passed to the AI gateway for Codex vs Claude runs?
Why is X-PostHog-Trace-Id set only for Codex and not Claude?
body:
Symptom: Rating a PostHog Slack answer on a Codex run points to an empty trace, and generations appear as isolated single-request traces in AI observability.
Root cause: products/desktop/packages/agent/src/server/agent-server.ts:AgentServer.configureEnvironment does not set X-PostHog-Trace-Id for Codex, so the gateway mints a fresh ID per request while the Codex adapter reports no trace ID.
Fix pattern: Stamp X-PostHog-Trace-Id with taskRunId on openaiCustomHeaders at process spawn, and inject it into turn-complete notifications via products/desktop/packages/agent/src/acp-extensions.ts:withTurnTraceId.
Constraints: Only set X-PostHog-Trace-Id for Codex; Claude CLI mints per-turn traceparent headers, and X-PostHog-Trace-Id outranks traceparent at the gateway, which would collapse Claude's per-turn traces into one run-level trace.
applies: PostHog desktop agent server gateway configuration and trace ID assignment for Codex and Claude runs.
